0.original: Maronne wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Weavers' Guild.

1.original: Maronne bids you present yourself to the man in charge of guild operations, a towering Roegadyn named Redolent Rose.

2.original: Redolent Rose grants you leave to study weaving. After providing you with a sewing needle, he instructs you to hold it as you would if you were about to attempt a stitch, and present yourself for inspection.

48.original: Are you ready to meet the guildmaster? First impressions are everything, and you do <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> want to present yourself poorly.

49.original: I suspected you might need more time. Very well─I shall not rush you.

50.original: Pray return when you have prepared yourself sufficiently. We will be here.

51.original: Excellent! Though I do wonder if your attire is appropriate for the occasion...

52.original: You will find the esteemed Redolent Rose supervising guild operations over yonder.

53.original: He is... How shall I put this? He is...relentless in his pursuit of excellence.

54.original: So long as you demonstrate that you are similarly committed, he will treat you fairly and with respect.

55.original: What do we have here? Another adventurer in search of thrills and excitement?

56.original: Shall I dance you a merry jig? No? Well, if this fails to please you, I suggest you run along─perhaps the women of the Ruby Road Exchange will be more to your liking.

57.original: ...Oh, so you mean to become a weaver? Then we have something to discuss after all.

58.original: I shall be blunt─weaving is an art, and, like all true artists, we must make sacrifices and suffer for our craft. So tell me, adventurer: are you prepared to <hex:021A020203>suffer<hex:021A020103>?

62.original: Then why are you here? Don't you know what you want? Or is it that you don't like what getting what you want entails? Either way, I don't want you.

63.original: So you say, but only time will tell.

64.original: In any case, you'll need equipment to get started. This needle should suffice for now.

65.original: I need not explain what a needle is, I trust?

66.original: Good. Then hold it as you would when sewing, and show me you're ready to begin.

67.original: You have unlocked a new class! You can change to this class at any time by equipping the tool received from this quest.

68.original: When changing classes, <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>gear sets<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will allow you to register and save your equipment. You may then use them to switch between classes instantly without the need to manually equip weapons or equipment.

69.original: A button for the Gear Set interface is located in the upper portion of the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Character<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> window.
